meta.note: Extracted values are marked 'From app.css' or 'From Chessground'; everything else is the new dark game-room direction.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the board. Light value from app.css body.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar, move list and player strips.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, the selected move chip, panel headers.

tokens.name: row-alt
tokens.usage: Every other move-list row.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels; input borders (3:1 against panel in both themes).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input, select and radio borders; meets 3:1 on panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel and panel-raised. Light value from app.css body.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Move numbers, captions, opening name; 4.5:1 on panel and row-alt.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (New game, Pair, Rematch). White text on it is 4.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary action hover.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: The 4px bottom edge under accent buttons (shadow-button).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring around any control; 3:1 on bg and panel.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: Rejected move, failed pairing, lost connection. Light value from app.css .notice.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Over the board while the promotion picker is open. From app.css .promotion.

tokens.name: board-light
tokens.usage: Light squares, both themes. Also the coordinate colour on dark squares.

tokens.name: board-dark
tokens.usage: Dark squares, both themes. Also the coordinate colour on light squares.

tokens.name: highlight-light
tokens.usage: Last-move from/to on a light square.

tokens.name: highlight-dark
tokens.usage: Last-move from/to on a dark square.

tokens.name: move-dest
tokens.usage: Legal-destination dot and selected square. From Chessground (move-dest, selected).

tokens.name: premove
tokens.usage: Premove square. From Chessground (current-premove).

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: Radial glow under a king in check. From Chessground (check).

tokens.name: eval-white
tokens.usage: White's share of the eval bar.

tokens.name: eval-black
tokens.usage: Black's share of the eval bar.

tokens.name: q-best
tokens.usage: Best-move badge fill (★). White glyph.

tokens.name: q-excellent
tokens.usage: Excellent badge fill (!). Ink-dark glyph.

tokens.name: q-great
tokens.usage: Great-move badge fill (!). White glyph.

tokens.name: q-inaccuracy
tokens.usage: Inaccuracy badge fill (?!). Ink-dark glyph. Blue/orange/yellow differ in lightness from the greens.

tokens.name: q-mistake
tokens.usage: Mistake badge fill (?). Ink-dark glyph.

tokens.name: q-blunder
tokens.usage: Blunder badge fill (??). White glyph.

tokens.name: q-ink
tokens.usage: Dark glyph on light badge fills (excellent, inaccuracy, mistake).

styles.name: result
styles.usage: Game result line. 1.25rem bold, from app.css .result.
styles.sample: game over: white wins by checkmate

styles.name: coord
styles.usage: Rank and file letters inside edge squares.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Status, notice and FEN lines. From app.css .status.

styles.name: eval
styles.usage: Eval chips and the eval-bar number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Coordinate inset inside edge squares. From app.css.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-control gap. From app.css .new-game label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge offset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Form gap, status margin, move-row padding. From app.css.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter and panel padding. From app.css main.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sidebar sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The board and its squares: always square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Selected move chip, eval chip, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Quality badges, avatar disc, promotion buttons. From app.css .promotion button.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Chunky edge under accent buttons; drops to 0 2px when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-button-secondary
tokens.usage: Edge under panel-raised buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-badge
tokens.usage: Quality badge sitting on a square corner.

tokens.name: board-max
tokens.usage: Board column max width. From app.css main max-width.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar beside the board at 960px+; below it, it stacks under the board.

tokens.name: eval-bar-width
tokens.usage: Eval bar to the left of the board.

tokens.name: control-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every input, select and button: thumb-sized on phones. From app.css.

tokens.name: badge-size
tokens.usage: Quality badge diameter (18px inline in the move list).

tokens.name: promotion-piece
tokens.usage: Each promotion button's width over the board. From app.css.

tokens.name: z-badge
tokens.usage: Quality badge over pieces.

tokens.name: z-promotion
tokens.usage: Promotion picker over the board. From app.css.
